analysis_only.rejected_assertion: All error-only native/open intermediate RAM states must be equal
analysis_only.reason: Each matches its own native and independent reference, but the different admitted input sequences can change the rotating selector and intermediate swap order; total edits are the same, not every intermediate state. This equality was never a protocol gate. No hardware rerun or evidence changes.

operations.result: An early closeout check refused while the final two controls were still running. No state was closed and no jobs stopped. Final closeout succeeded only after 16 audits and a free-device check.
